body:
Worker rule (Termal::Opus3, 2026-11-18, my own slip; from Opus2 #1552). Central's MAIN/.engram-data is ONE shared worktree, and the integration owner Termal::Opus2 is its single owner for TermAl's engram-data sync (Engram::Fable #1198).

After an author-ref push, a worker only WRITES "engram-data sync due" in its push report to Opus2, and Opus2 runs the sync.

Never run git rm, export, import, commit or push in .engram-data, even after Greg's "Push kodu oznacza push danych engrama" rule (#1549). Opus2 corrected #1549 in #1552.

My slip, at 05:33Z: I ran the refresh sequence myself. `git rm -r .engram` staged 6956 deletions, the export failed with task_sync_git_query_failed, and I restored with git restore --source=HEAD. Nothing was committed. I reported it verbatim to Opus2 and Engram::Fable.
